note: Generated by `cargo xtask schema` from the Stress Lab's switches (apps/stress-lab/src/catalog.rs) and the engine switches every host takes (crates/engine/src/host/settings.rs); do not edit. The optional features a workload can switch: each name is the page's parameter and the native option, which take the same values.

options.name: look
options.what: lighting preset over the scene's own

options.name: effects
options.what: all, none, or comma-separated no-<effect> exclusions

options.name: visibility
options.what: on: shade virtual geometry through the visibility buffer

options.name: lod
options.what: off: draw every instance as its mesh

options.name: presentation
options.what: how ordinary frames are presented: blended, composed and culled on the GPU, or exactly on the CPU

options.name: pipeline
options.what: fixed ticks split across the frames around their due time, on GPU-presented frames

options.name: taa
options.what: temporal antialiasing of GPU-presented frames, over the scene's setting

options.name: occlusion
options.what: occlusion culling of GPU-presented frames, over the scene's setting

options.name: subpixel
options.what: sub-pixel culling of GPU-presented frames, over the scene's setting

options.name: terrain-clock
options.what: what terrain times its work by: the host's clock, or frames alone, each a slice of samples_per_frame with none between them
